item.title: Gharibabadi: Sovereignty and territorial integrity of states are not subject to violation or negotiation
item.description: Tehran, IRNA – Iranian Deputy Foreign Minister for Legal and International Affairs Kazem Gharibabadi, noting that the credibility of international law hinges on the equality of states before the law, added: The Islamic Republic of Iran believes that if international law is to truly safeguard peace, justice, and human dignity, it cannot be a set of selective rules—rigorously enforced against some states while disregarded for others due to political considerations and power dynamics.
item.content:encoded:
Original source: https://en.irna.ir/news/86274384/Gharibabadi-Sovereignty-and-territorial-integrity-of-states

Tehran, IRNA – Iranian Deputy Foreign Minister for Legal and International Affairs Kazem Gharibabadi, noting that the credibility of international law hinges on the equality of states before the law, added: The Islamic Republic of Iran believes that if international law is to truly safeguard peace, justice, and human dignity, it cannot be a set of selective rules—rigorously enforced against some states while disregarded for others due to political considerations and power dynamics.

item.title: Baqaei: Europe must be held accountable for its participation in aggression against Iran
item.description: Tehran, IRNA – Foreign Ministry spokesperson Esmaeil Baqaei In response to the NATO Secretary General's remarks regarding military assistance to the US and the Zionist regime for an act of aggression against Iran, has said that the European Union, its member states, and NATO members must be held accountable for their role and participation in the military aggression by the US and the Israeli regime against Iran.
